summary: Creates camera-facing quad sprite geometry at positions supplied by CHOP samples, with optional width, color, alpha, and constant-width falloff controls.

key_params.name: constantwidth
key_params.note: Blend between perspective and constant width

key_params.name: constantwitdhfar
key_params.note: Far constant width, preserving official misspelling

common_gotchas: xyzchop is required and must provide exactly three position channels.
The camera path must be valid for billboarding.
Width, color, and alpha CHOP sample counts should match intended sprite count.
The official far-width id is misspelled constantwitdhfar and must be preserved exactly.
key_concepts: Sprite SOP creates quad sprites at positions from the XYZ CHOP parameter.
xyzchop requires three channels, and each sample creates one centered quad.
Generated quads always face the specified Camera COMP.
Optional CHOPs drive width, RGB color, and alpha per sample.
Constant-width parameters blend perspective width with near/far falloff widths.
